name: justtranscribe
description: Transcribe public videos and audio (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, Pinterest, Google Drive links) into accurate, timestamped text without leaving the chat — then summarize, translate, quote with timestamps, or export SRT/VTT subtitles. Spanish, English and dozens of languages are auto-detected; the service is Spanish-first for Latin America. Typical users: students transcribing recorded classes, journalists and professionals working from interviews and voice notes, creators studying social videos.

_published_faq.name: How do I add justtranscribe to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add justtranscribe to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://justtranscribe.ai/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the justtranscribe MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: justtranscribe provides these MCP tools: delete_transcript, export_transcript, get_account, get_transcript, list_transcripts, and transcribe_url.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to justtranscribe?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to justtranscribe in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
justtranscribe requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
justtranscribe is developed by Unai. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
